counter_contract: calls=min(u64::MAX,advanced+completed+failed); exact source uses one outcome per call and saturating counters; maximum<=saturating sum; recorded minima do not exceed first/last respective values.
canonical_json: exact serde field order/compact ASCII shape; no duplicate/extra/missing keys, floats, signs, nonfinite, escaped static spellings, extra whitespace or CRLF. New public u64/u128 values are decimal strings.
whitelist_scope: 39 pairs derived from four normal failure scopes plus three normal timing spans in actual 495 sources. Not a claim of exhaustive repository-wide discovery. Any other pair causes fail-closed diagnostic refusal with a fixed code, never reflection or silent acceptance. The test-only local_stage_batch spans are excluded.
threat_and_limits: No request-ID field exists; class ordinary is not a route.
No assumed content or correlation for input line178.
Original two public marker types preserve line order around any new marker.
A missing, rejected, truncated-by-source-bucket-bound or failed-to-log record cannot diagnose the request.
The final output cap remains64KiB even if many valid timing lines would exceed it; this is a refusal, not a larger output budget.
Component execution is pure selected-parser and AST compile only, not actual log/FD/host qualification.

input_binding.input_identity_source: raw stat/FD fields, not a native connector version token
